description: This file defines the 'InputManagerCompat' interface which abstracts input device management, including device querying, listener registration, and event handling, with conditional support for different Android API levels.

classes.name: InputManagerCompat
classes.description: An interface providing access to input device management features with support for device querying, event processing, and listener registration, compatible across Android API levels.

classes.name: InputManagerCompat.InputDeviceListener
classes.description: An inner interface within InputManagerCompat for listening to input device addition, change, and removal events.

classes.name: InputManagerCompat.Factory
classes.description: A static inner class providing a factory method to create appropriate InputManagerCompat instances depending on the Android API level.

methods.name: getInputDevice
methods.description: Returns the InputDevice with the specified id, or null if not found.

methods.name: getInputDeviceIds
methods.description: Returns an array of all input device ids present in the system.

methods.name: registerInputDeviceListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for input device events with an optional handler context.

methods.name: unregisterInputDeviceListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered input device listener.

methods.name: onGenericMotionEvent
methods.description: Feeds a MotionEvent into the input manager for polling optimization.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Informs the input manager to stop polling for disconnected devices.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Informs the input manager to start polling for disconnected devices.

methods.name: Factory.getInputManager
methods.description: Factory method that returns a suitable implementation of InputManagerCompat based on Android API level.
